title: dormancy: a suite wholly behind features reads INCONCLUSIVE, --all-features lands after a --, and the declared line it prints can name a command that never runs
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 by 0115's page agent for `dormancy`, and driven again by cc at 4c9d5a7 with a stub cargo that prints cargo's `test result:` trailer. Four points in lib/cmd/dormancy.

1. A SUITE WHOLLY BEHIND FEATURES READS INCONCLUSIVE, NOT A COUNT. The declared leg runs `test rust` under the cargo grammar, and run_gate promotes a zero-executed run to failed (lib/runlog:1765-1782). The legs pass no --allow-empty (lib/cmd/dormancy:101), so the declared leg exits 1 and dormancy reports INCONCLUSIVE (:184-191). DRIVEN: declared 0 and maximum 4 printed "PROMOTED TO FAILED (test rust): 0 tests executed", then "DORMANCY INCONCLUSIVE ... declared: 0 (exit 1) ... maximum: 4 (exit 0)". The control, declared 2, printed "DORMANT: 2 test(s) run ONLY under --all-features." So the case this command exists to find, a suite that runs nothing by default, is the one it cannot report.

2. `--all-features` LANDS AFTER A `--`. The second leg appends the flag to the declared line (:171), and the header prints the same (:162), so `run: cargo test -- --test-threads=1` becomes `cargo test -- --test-threads=1 --all-features`. The flag goes to the test binaries, which reject it, and never reaches cargo. DRIVEN, with the stub rejecting it after `--` as libtest does: "maximum: no test trailer at all (exit 101)", INCONCLUSIVE.

3. THE DECLARED LINE IT PRINTS CAN NAME A COMMAND THAT NEVER RUNS. _dormancy_declared reads commands.test.options.rust.run, else the catalogue (:71-77), and never asks what runs `test rust`. DRIVEN:
- With a project test handler, it printed "declared cargo test"; the handler ran both legs and no cargo ran at all.
- With `test rust` disabled, it printed "declared cargo test"; both legs were refused with exit 2, and it reported INCONCLUSIVE instead of refusing before it started.

4. AN EMPTY DECLARED LINE COUNTS AS UNDECLARED. The test is `[ -n "$run" ]` (:75). 0082's rule, which every other reader of the key follows, is cfg_has (lib/resolve:708-716). DRIVEN with `run: ""`: it printed "declared cargo test", then both legs failed with "holds no words" and it reported INCONCLUSIVE.

WHAT A FIX MUST DO:
- Count a zero rather than refuse it. The legs are a measurement, not a gate, so they run with --allow-empty or read the trailer before any promotion.
- Put --all-features where cargo reads it: before any `--`.
- Refuse up front, naming why, when `test rust` will not run as the line dormancy prints: a test handler, a disabled option, an empty line.
- Read the declared line through cfg_has.

PAGES. 0115's dormancy.md describes the printed line at line 12 and INCONCLUSIVE at line 23 as they are today. Both change with the fix. It ships in 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. cc's.

## Resolution

Fixed at c6daed8. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. dormancy runs the line `test rust` runs here, asked of the dispatcher (option_leaf), and refuses before either leg, in the dispatcher's own words, when that is not a cargo test line of test rust's own: a project handler, a command-level run:, test rust or test switched off, a line with no words (cfg_has, 0082's rule), a missing devbin handler, a line declared unsealed, and a config that is missing or will not load. Each leg runs the line itself through run_gate, --allow-empty given to run_gate and never to cargo, so a suite wholly behind features reads DORMANT rather than INCONCLUSIVE (point 1). --all-features goes before the first `--`, where cargo reads it (point 2). The header prints the line and where it came from (points 3 and 4). Each leg is sealed as `test rust` is, by option_seal, the one statement of an option's seal, which run_option and gatecmd now ask too, and each is a run of its own, minted by lib/runlog's run_id_mint in bin/devbin's format, which a contract arm holds to that format. dormancy's language guard reads the dispatcher's one-a-line language list, so a project declaring rust beside another language is measured; it never was before (found while arming, older than 0135). The page says each.
- NOT CHANGED, ON THE RECORD. With devbin's own test handler missing from the install, `bin/devbin test rust` prints only its usage line at exit 1, since command_tier answers `options`, where every other path to a missing handler reports unrunnable at exit 3; dormancy reads that `options` answer as unrunnable_why's reason, and the dispatcher's answer, 0128's command_tier and run_command, is held by vc for hv. fullcycle, doctor, upgrade, install and shell-init each load the config in their own way, and fullcycle's swallows a failure as dormancy's did; reachable only by a direct invocation, it is parked for hv as a refactor across handlers, with dormancy's refusal as the model.
- REVIEWS. critic-shell's passes: on v1 (1 warning, the legs kept a parent's run id; 4 recommendations; 1 style), on v2c (1 warning, the language guard's lost default under set -u; 3 recommendations, one of them the swallowed config load, folded in as a refusal; 1 style), and on v2e under vc's convergence rule (0 critical, 0 warnings, no false green; its prose correction and style point taken as v2f); each point built or answered, and the commit message names each with the pass that raised it. vc's review: vc, 2026-09-25, approved at v2f on the rulings built as ruled, the drives and the evidence below; the final suite over the landed stack is below.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. v1's arms red at 632e661 at their own assertions, and each revision's over the code before it; the controls, which hold behaviour the code already had, are held by mutants. 28 mutants, each against its own arm after every killer ran green: 27 killed on v2e, and S5, a mint reading $$, killed by clock timing in v2c's batch and surviving in v2e's, is killed on v2f against an arm that requires the two legs' ids to differ in their pid half.
- THE SUITE. All of tests/unit over the six remaining 0.1.8 changes stacked in landing order on a252178 (0134, 0135, 0145, 0149, 0148, 0150), on a clean checkout built from the six exports (head 55f4c7e, tree 840726e0, the build stack's own tree), 2026-09-26 02:11:38Z to 02:46:47Z: 2040 of 2040 ok, 0 not ok, its 5 skips the declared ones (two no-tty branches, two require_command arms that skip off CI, the case-sensitive rename arm on this case-folding disk); the arms that need real cargo ran. Main after the landing is byte-identical to that tree.
